observabilityScopes.title: observabilityScopes

ampScopes.description: Full list of AMP OAuth2 scopes that interactive clients are allowed to request. Thunder only grants scopes that appear in an app's registered scope list, so all permission scopes must be declared here for role-based access to work. Exception: am-mcp's allowance is this catalog MINUS observabilityScopes (filtered in 59-am-mcp-client.yaml) — those scopes are owned exclusively by the observer MCP client (amObsMcpClient below).
